name: chop-inherit-rg-tags-VM-backup
displayName: CHOP Inherit a tag from the resource group if missing - Virtual Machines only - backup
description: Adds the specified tag with its value from the parent resource group when VM is missing this tag is created or updated. Existing VM can be remediated by triggering a remediation task. If the tag exists with a different value it will not be changed.

metadata.description: Name of the tag, such as 'environment'
